title: ZDI publishes Pwn2Own advisory on hard-coded ssh credentials in ChargePoint Home Flex (CVE-2026-131816)
date_note: ZDI's advisory records its publication on 2026-11-24; the page gives no earlier public day.
summary: Zero Day Initiative's advisory ZDI-26-1112, a Pwn2Own entry, describes hard-coded credentials in the ssh service of the ChargePoint Home Flex EV charger. ZDI says a network-adjacent attacker can bypass authentication without credentials. The advisory lists a fix in firmware version 2024.02.00.259-alpha and was published on 2026-11-24.
plain: ZDI says the ssh service on the ChargePoint Home Flex home EV charger uses hard-coded credentials, so someone on the same network can get in without a login. The advisory lists a firmware fix.
exec: ZDI says hard-coded ssh credentials let a network-adjacent attacker bypass authentication on ChargePoint Home Flex chargers; the advisory lists a firmware fix.
action: ZDI's advisory lists the fix as Home Flex firmware version 2024.02.00.259-alpha.

validation.note: Single source: ZDI's own advisory. ChargePoint's own page was not read.

review.note: action advice: removed unsourced advice; now states ZDI's listed fix. Title, CVE, date, fix version checked against ZDI advisory
